recentItems.description: Fantasy is more than an empty dream. Meet the hero and characters of Metaphor: ReFantazio in this latest trailer for the RPG. Metaphor: ReFantazio launches on Nintendo Switch 2 today, November 12, 2026. It is also available now on PC, Xbox, and PlayStation.

recentItems.title: War Thunder - Official DLSS 5 Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
Get a look at the DLSS 5 Launch Trailer for War Thunder, the hit vehicular war action game developed by Gaijin Entertainment. Players can take to the skies and battlefields alike in unprecedented visual fidelity courtesy of NVIDIA's DLSS 5 technology. Enjoy DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering in the latest Eagle Shadow update for War Thunder, available now on PC.

Source: https://youtube.com/nvidia

recentItems.title: Shrek 2 Remastered - Shrek-tastic Gameplay
recentItems.description:
Checkout gameplay for DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.

Played on PC. NVIDIA RTX 5090

recentItems.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time - How to Unlock the Gerudo Valley Entrance Chest
recentItems.description:
In the Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake, if you travel all the way out toward the entrance to Gerudo Valley, you'll find a small Treasure Chest under a large rock outcropping. If you try to open this as a kid upon first encountering it, it will tell you it’s locked. Here's how to open it!

recentItems.title: PlayStation 5 Crosses 100 Million Sold Milestone - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Sony has announced the PS5 has crossed a major milestone: 100 million units sold since its November 2020 launch. This does not mean actually sold through to customers, but it's a good benchmark for how well the console is performing, sales-wise. The current reigning champ of console sales is the PS2 with more than 160 million sold, with the Nintendo Switch right behind it with around 157 million. In other sales news, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarins of Time remake for Switch 2 has sold an impressive 5 million in four days, making it the fastest-selling game on the Switch 2 so far. And finally, former Tekken boss Katsuhiro Harada had some harsh words for the Xbox Series S, calling it the "weaker child" of the Xbox Series family, and wishing it hadn't been released.
